questions.question: Akash leaves from his school at 5:30 a.m. He starts walking towards the south and covers a distance of 20 km. He turns left and walks 15 km to reach point A. He turns right and walks 14 km. He again turns right and walks 10 km. How far (in km) and in which direction is he now from point A?

Ship A is 24 Km south with respect to ship B.

questions.question: Two cruisers start from the same port. Cruiser A sails 50 miles South, then it turns right and sails 60 miles. In the meanwhile, cruiser B sails 105 miles West, then it turns left and sails 50 miles, then it turns West and sails 45 miles. Where is cruiser A with respect to cruiser B?

Ganga leaves from her college at 10:00 a.m. She starts walking towards north and covers a distance of 14 km. She turns right and walks 20 km to reach point K. She turns left and walk 16 km. She again turns left and walks 10 km. How far (in km) and in which direction is she now from point K?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f5d708e0157ce98e82653e25784cd932129d20b1c29d6b603e44841c38ad023.png] 

Distance = sqrt {{{10}²} + {{16}²}} km → 2sqrt {89 } km

Hence, answer is 2√89, North-West.

questions.solution:
The flow of river from town A to to town B is shown below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9958162d1e87eaeb8a12f672b77c8d7605208684c44e87ac0afe3bd56e6a3472.png] 

Thus, town A is 3 miles South with respect to town B.
